review.rationale: The Decision safely authorizes exactly one later, separate, offline lineage reconciliation. The recommendation chain and review are qualifying and remote-verified. All artifact, commit, ancestry, and PR27 contracts are exact and bounded. Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN and is not promoted. Execution is strictly separated from decision preparation, with read-only fetches and metadata reads, and zero SSH/server/public-site/repair/rollback/redeployment/release/PR-mutation authority. Git lineage is explicitly barred from becoming deployment authority, root cause, safety, production readiness, or commercial truth. Caps and stop conditions are sufficient and enforce fail-closed behavior.
